heroSubtitle: Full-color printed brand labels and garment care content labels for clothing brands and apparel manufacturers. Smooth, soft and wash-friendly finishes for every garment type.
buyerSummary: Printed brand labels and care content labels for apparel — full-color brand tags, size labels and wash-care information with a soft, smooth finish.
overviewParagraphs: Custom printed labels and care labels carry brand identification, size and garment care information directly on clothing and accessories. Printed labels support full-color logos, small text and variable content that woven labels cannot always reproduce economically.

Care labels communicate washing, drying and material instructions required by many destination markets. We print on satin, cotton, Tyvek or coated stock depending on the garment, feel and wash requirements of your project.

faqs.question: What is the MOQ for printed and care labels?
faqs.answer: MOQ: 200 pcs per design and construction for bulk production.

faqs.question: Can I request a pre-production sample?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production sample development is available for custom projects so you can verify material, print quality and fold before bulk production.

faqs.question: Can I submit an inquiry without final artwork?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can submit your project now and send artwork or care-label content later.

faqs.question: What design files can I send?
faqs.answer: PNG, JPG, PDF, AI or SVG files work well. For care labels, clear text content for washing, drying and material instructions is helpful.

faqs.question: Can you help choose the right label material?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our team can recommend satin, cotton or Tyvek based on the garment type, feel and wash requirements of your project.

faqs.question: Can you provide test reports?
faqs.answer: Test reports and compliance documentation can be supported according to selected materials, product construction and destination-market requirements.

faqs.question: How are labels packed and shipped?
faqs.answer: Rolls, bundles or individual packing are available, and shipment is arranged according to your confirmed order and destination.
